findings.criterion: Local, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, and bare bridge execution use one runner contract.
findings.detail: The shared runner-neutral entrypoint `scripts/run_reconcile_bridge.py` does not exist in the repository. The scripts/ directory listing confirms no such file, and a search for the key constant `CANONICAL_EXIT_CODES` returns no matches anywhere. Without this shared entrypoint, the single runner contract across Local, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, and bare bridge execution cannot be verified.
findings.remediation: Create scripts/run_reconcile_bridge.py with the unified runner contract (including CANONICAL_EXIT_CODES) and update all CI provider configs (GitHub Actions, Jenkinsfile, .gitlab-ci.yml) and local/bare bridge invocations to use it. Then re-verify the criterion.
findings.title: Runner-neutral entrypoint missing
